scope: Read-only offline analysis of the first normalized_cost crossing, matching raw VINS telemetry, truth-only evaluator samples, commanded trajectory, and fixed-SE(3) alignment. No flight, parameter, control, or health-gate behavior changed.

result.feature_tracking: At crossing, input/stereo/long-track counts were 70/70/43 versus previous-ten medians 58.5/50.5/36; this does not indicate a feature-count collapse.

single_sample_cost_decomposition.qualification: The available sample is visual-dominated, but only one sample has group costs; this does not identify why the visual cost rose.

whole_flight_alignment.qualification: Correlation spans the full recorded interval, including the post-abort landing; it is not causal evidence.

supported: The first gate crossing occurred during the requested low-speed translation and climb, not during a static hover.
Tracked-feature counts were above their immediately preceding medians, while the single available grouped cost sample was dominated by the visual group and had very small IMU cost.
The action was aborted and the position command canceled about 81 ms after the first over-limit quality sample.
unresolved: The specific visual residual source is unknown; images and per-feature residual distributions were not captured, and group-cost decomposition exists for only one sample.
This run does not justify changing the 1.0 health threshold or adding a debounce policy.

qualification.P5: IN_PROGRESS; the goal action aborted and is not a P5 pass.
qualification.truth_isolation: Truth was used only by the offline evaluator; it was not an input to navigation or PX4 control.

reproduction.note: The regenerated JSON at /tmp was byte-compared with the saved run-local output.
reproduction.result: PASS: Python AST parse succeeded and deterministic output matched byte-for-byte.
